team-execution.title: Team execution
team-execution.intro: Follow project team plans, inspect blocked work and open the original tasks and runs. This list updates when you refresh it.
team-execution.acceptance_boundary: Progress counts formally accepted tasks. Successful runs and passing tests still require the task's formal review.
team-execution.stale: Previously loaded results are shown. Current state and access could not be confirmed; refresh before relying on them.
team-execution.page_scope: Loaded {{loaded}} of {{total}} project plans visible to you. Filters count loaded plans.
team-execution.team_page_scope: Loaded {{loaded}} of {{total}} plans visible to you for this team. Filters count loaded plans.
team-execution.invalid_team: This team filter is invalid. Clear it to view project plans.
team-execution.empty_team_help: Clear the team filter to view the other plans available in this project.
team-execution.facet_empty: No loaded plans match. Change the filter or load more when available.
team-execution.empty_help: Select project tasks to prepare a team plan. Preparing a preview does not start execution.
team-execution.invalid_link: This team plan link is invalid. Return to the list and choose an existing plan.
team-execution.source_changed: Some fixed inputs or permissions need review. Open the plan to inspect its current blockers.
